method: Reconcile every complete 604 pattern with ordered same-UIC OSM relation stops. Inspect the exact local inbound source-way chain without replacing the original SLOID coordinates. Inventory every returned road/restriction. Independently replay operator poster departures by source service day and retain civil-window carry-in/tail trips. No geometry or admission API.
decision: Retain 67 Friday and 38 Sunday inbound exclusions. Ordered OSM relations identify the inbound Grienbach node but provide no authoritative replacement SLOID mapping; its gap remains about 189 m. The local relation chain also exceeds the original 120 m projection limit. OSM outbound relations still traverse Grienbachstrasse despite the dated outbound diversion. The operator poster corroborates all source-day departure times and the one-minute Grienbach–V-Zug interval; calendar/window boundaries account for the apparent count discrepancy.
